ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - Texas State University

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-years). The residency split comes from its applications table (in-state 36,941 / out-of-state 5,351 / international 2,117 / unknown 27 applicants); international admit rate is 96.2% (2,037 of 2,117), 442 enrolled. The Common Data Set does not report high school GPA, so GPA is not shown; 12% of enrollees were in the top tenth and 42% in the top quarter of their class. Undergraduate enrollment is 39,353 (total undergraduates); the international figure of 1,205 is degree-seeking nonresidents. Student-faculty ratio 21:1 is from IPEDS College Navigator. Waitlist: none.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'required for some' and ACT-only / SAT-only 'recommended'. Its note says scores are not required for students in the top 75% of their class and are required in the bottom 25%.

cost.notes: First-year full-year amounts from the Common Data Set; room and board is on-campus housing $8,076 plus meal plan $4,824. The Common Data Set text refers to both 2025-26 and 2026-27, so the year is most likely 2025-26 (IPEDS 2024-25 was $11,450 in-state / $22,930 out-of-state tuition and fees). 1,131 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional need-based or non-need-based aid (avg $22,760, total $25,741,960); nonresident first-years file the International Student's Financial Aid Application
